description: Checks a domain's SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and TLS, blacklists, website and age, the way Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft judge a sender. Returns a setup score out of 100, a readiness verdict, and each problem with how to fix it. Also accepts a public IPv4 address (blacklists and reverse DNS).

selector.description: DKIM selector to check, if known (the s= value in a DKIM-Signature header)

name: check_domain
title: Check a domain's email setup
